03 / Projects

Selected work.

Two builds that show both sides of the job: securing systems in software, and designing the networks underneath them.

CLIENT-SERVER · SIEM · REAL-TIME MONITORING

Full-stack security monitoring & SIEM platform

A Python client agent runs on endpoint devices and streams telemetry to an asynchronous server, which correlates activity, flags threats, and surfaces everything through a live web dashboard.

Python aiohttp WebSockets Scapy SQLite Watchdog PyInstaller
Endpoint monitoring

Tracks running processes, network connections, file-system changes, and Windows Event Logs across every connected device.

Threat detection engine

Custom rule set flags suspicious processes, unusual remote ports, and dangerous commands in real time.

Live traffic analysis

On-device packet capture and inspection using Scapy, feeding directly into the detection pipeline.

SOC dashboard

Authenticated web dashboard with live alerts, device management, and remote SSH shell access to endpoints.

Threat intelligence

VirusTotal lookups plus an AI chat assistant for reasoning about alerts and IP reputation.

Instant alerting

Telegram bot integration pushes real-time notifications the moment a threat is flagged.

ENTERPRISE NETWORK · ROUTING & SWITCHING · CISCO PACKET TRACER

Enterprise network infrastructure design

A full enterprise-grade network built in Cisco Packet Tracer — combining routing, VLAN segmentation, core services, VoIP, and centralized access control into one cohesive topology.

VLAN OSPF Static Routing ACL Firewall EtherChannel VTP / DTP DHCP DNS / SMTP / HTTP(S) SSH / Telnet RADIUS / TACACS+
Routing & switching

Combined static and dynamic (OSPF) routing for optimized, redundant path selection across all network segments.

VLAN segmentation

VTP and DTP configured for centralized VLAN management and automatic trunk negotiation between switches.

Link redundancy

EtherChannel bundles multiple switch links for increased bandwidth and failover resilience.

Perimeter security

Firewall and ACLs enforce traffic filtering and segmentation policies between VLANs.

Core network services

DNS, SMTP, HTTP/HTTPS, and DHCP servers deployed, plus router-based DHCP for segments without a dedicated server.

VoIP across VLANs

IP phones distributed across separate voice VLANs with seamless inter-VLAN communication via routing.

Remote administration

Secure device management enabled over SSH and Telnet.

AAA access control

RADIUS and TACACS+ servers configured with local fallback authentication for centralized network access control.

04 / Architecture

How the pieces fit together.

Two ways of thinking about a system: how it detects threats, and how it moves traffic.

SOC / SIEM DATA FLOW

Endpoint and network signals flow into a collector, get scored by the detection engine, and land in the SIEM core — which feeds both the live dashboard and outbound alerts.

NETWORK TOPOLOGY

Traffic enters through the firewall, hits the core switch, and fans out across VLANs for data, voice, and servers — with AAA guarding every login along the way.
